description.zh:
文件名称。
> 文件名称需要以txt、sql结尾。例如test.txt、test.sql。
description.en:
The name of the attachment file.

>  The file name must end with .txt or .sql. For example, the file name can be test.txt or test.sql.

description.zh:
上传附件的使用目的，取值说明如下：
- **datacorrect**：数据变更工单。
- **order_info_attachment**：工单附件。
- **big-file**：批量数据导入。
- **sqlreview**：SQL审核。
description.en:
The purpose of the attachment file. Valid values:

*   **datacorrect**: The file is uploaded to change data.
*   **order_info_attachment**: The file is uploaded as an attachment in a ticket.
*   **big-file**: The file is uploaded to import multiple data records at a time.
*   **sqlreview**: The file is uploaded for SQL review.

The ID of the tenant.

>  You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to query the tenant ID.

description.zh:
上传附件URL链接，此处链接仅支持HTTP和HTTPS链接。
> 您可以将文件（Object）上传至存储空间（Bucket）后，获取文件的分享URL，更多信息，请参见[分享文件](~~195674~~)。
description.en:
The URL of the attachment file. The URL must be an HTTP URL or an HTTPS URL.

>  You can upload the attachment file to an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket and obtain the URL of the file in the OSS console. For more information, see [Share objects](~~195674~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise create-upload-file-job --file-source datacorrect --file-name test.txt --upload-url https://XXX.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/test.txt --tid 1 --region cn-hangzhou
